human_tolerance.notes: Adapts to suburban areas and urban parks, though less than the red fox (Wikipedia). Setts are in woodland and hedgerow banks; rests in setts by day.

phases.name: mating
phases.note: Peak mating season February to May; sows can mate at any time of year (Wikipedia).

phases.name: young
phases.note: Cubs born mid-January to mid-March; they emerge from the sett at about eight weeks and are weaned from about twelve weeks (Wikipedia).

phases.name: territorial
phases.note: Boars mark territories more actively and intrude into neighbouring territories in early spring (Wikipedia).

vocalizations.description: Deep growl given when threatened (Wikipedia: 'When threatened, they emit deep growls').
Bark given when surprised (Wikipedia: 'They bark when surprised').
Piercing scream when alarmed or frightened (Wikipedia: 'a piercing scream when alarmed or frightened').
Low kekkering noise during fights between badgers (Wikipedia: 'low kekkering noises' when fighting).

range.note: Country list transcribed from Wikipedia's Distribution section (Europe and Caucasus countries). Native status and the Volga/Caucasian boundary are from the same section; Russia is listed in full as the Volga boundary is not country-resolved.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Walking and fast running: 'they can move quickly at full gallop'. Trot and swim not stated; omitted.

traits.mass_kg.note: PanTHERIA AdultBodyMass 11884.03 g rounded to 11.9 kg; EltonTraits BodyMass-Value 13000 g (Walker's Mammals of the World via Nowak 1999). Wikipedia gives 7-13 kg in spring and 15-17 kg in autumn; the annual midpoint is consistent with 11.9 kg.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Lower bound 7 kg (spring weight), upper bound 17 kg (autumn weight), both from Wikipedia 'Description'.

traits.length_m.note: Body length midpoint of 60-90 cm (0.75 m) plus tail midpoint of 12-24 cm (0.18 m).

traits.shoulder_height_m.note: Midpoint of 25-30 cm at the shoulder.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Authored judgement, not a sourced typical value. Sources give maxima only: Wikipedia 'up to about fifteen years in the wild'; PanTHERIA MaxLongevity 194.4 months (about 16.2 y). A maximum is not a typical lifespan, so the typical value 4 y is a low-confidence judgement.

traits.home_range_ha.note: PanTHERIA HomeRange 1.20 km2 (120 ha) as a global mean; Wikipedia territories are 30-150 ha.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 20, Diet-Vend 20 + Diet-Vect 20 = vertebrate 40, Diet-Fruit 20, Diet-Seed 10, Diet-PlantO 10 mapped to graze. Wikipedia says earthworms are the most important food, which EltonTraits' 20% invertebrate share understates; the record keeps the EltonTraits split. EltonTraits Diet-Scav 0; carrion is in Wikipedia but has no share here.

traits.social.note: 'Groups of six adults on average, though ... up to 23'. Structure Group.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Wikipedia: 'It is nocturnal and social'. Conflicts: EltonTraits Activity-Diurnal = 1 (Nowak 1999); PanTHERIA 1-1_ActivityCycle = 2 (crepuscular). Nocturnal chosen from the most specific article statement; unresolved.

traits.defense.note: Retreats to the sett; 'may fight viciously ... if cornered' (Wikipedia). Flee chosen as the main response.

traits.wariness.note: Authored judgement: avoids people at the sett but tolerates suburban and urban fringe use.

habitat.use.note: Authored: ground-living with about one fifth of time underground in setts.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Setts: 'comprise extensive systems of underground passages'.

habitat.resources.note: Weights follow the diet shares; months for fruit (windfall autumn fruit) and seed (cereal harvest) from Wikipedia 'Diet'.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: 'adapted to living in suburban areas and urban parks, though not to the same extent as red foxes'. Urban affinity Adapter.

seasonal.strategy.note: Wikipedia describes winter sleep only in Russia and the Nordic countries; in England and Transcaucasia badgers forgo it or emerge in mild spells. France is not described, so ActiveYearRound is used. Limitation: northern dormancy is not modelled.

seasonal.phases.note: Mating peak February to May and cub birth mid-January to mid-March from Wikipedia 'Reproduction'; the 07-31 end of young is authored from the weaning and emergence timings.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Juvenile duration 365 days from 'sexual maturity in boars at twelve to fifteen months'; scale 0.6 is authored.

look.note: Colours from Wikipedia 'Fur': silvery-grey back, black throat and legs, black head bands, white forehead and white ear tips. Proportions and extra-part sizes are authored.

behavior.note: Authored parameters for the shared ground-forager program: only food_tag set to invertebrate; the rest of the parameters use the program defaults.

vocalizations.growl.note: Growl given when threatened, from Wikipedia Behaviour. Dusk/night windows and 10 s cooldown are authored.

vocalizations.bark.note: Bark given when surprised, from Wikipedia Behaviour. Dusk/night windows and 20 s cooldown are authored.

vocalizations.scream.note: Piercing scream when alarmed or frightened, from Wikipedia Behaviour. Night window and 90 s cooldown are authored.

vocalizations.kekkering.note: Low kekkering noise in fights, from Wikipedia Behaviour. Months 2-5 derived from the early-spring territorial and mating peak; windows authored.
